answer: Each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash of the task, agent identity, and a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature remains unpredictable until quorum release. A sybil swarm therefore cannot precompute valid responses, forge prior beacon values, or farm an answer library offline; every identity must solve a fresh, beacon-bound task. The released pulse also provides a lantern for audit, linking each result to its round in an immutable verification thread.
